n: A robot can practice in a simulation thousands of times before it ever takes a real step. Your work has a version of this. Before you send an AI tool into something that matters, give it a practice run on a copy: last month's report, an old inbox, a made-up client. See where it stumbles while nothing is at stake. Then send it to the real thing.
